**RidgeKey 1.1.1** - fixes the sidebar in the RidgeKey app.

In 1.1.0 the sidebar (Overview, Fingerprints, Finger Actions, ...) did not respond to clicks.
Nothing else changed; fingerprints, the stored password and settings are kept.

### Update
- **From 1.1.0:** RidgeKey menu → **Check for Updates…**, or in Terminal: `ridgekey-update install`.
- **From 1.0:** download **`RidgeKey-1.1.1.pkg`** below and open it (right-click → **Open** the first time).

Full history: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/labrouss/RidgeKey/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
